rationale: Builds directly on the current late-aligned recurrent-tail best. The replayed tail blocks now reuse their own first-pass decoder inputs as stage-local anchors instead of the global embedding anchor, which is a minimal gated-carryover transplant: no new parameters, no extra compile variants, and the byte budget stays essentially unchanged while giving the recurrent tail a sharper, depth-local reuse signal under the 600s cap.
title: Fixed First-Pass Carry Anchor For Recurrent Tail
